The Parabolic Short

Justin Neel
The Bear of Wall Street
•18 min •Intermediate •Updated Sep 2026
OverviewResourcesNotesQ&A

The parabolic phase is where the crowd is most confident and most wrong. In this lesson we break down how a low-float runner goes vertical, why the last leg is fueled by shorts covering and FOMO, and how to position before the exhaustion candle instead of chasing it.

B What you’ll learn

  • Why the parabolic phase is where the crowd is most wrong
  • The three tells that a runner is losing steam
  • How to stage a starter before the exhaustion candle confirms
  • Where your stop belongs so you can be wrong cheaply
